name: Subhas Chandra Bose
role: Nationalist leader with major Bengal political roots
contribution: He advanced a militant anti-colonial strategy and became one of the most influential nationalist leaders tied to Bengal political mobilization.
context: From Calcutta political circles to all-India leadership, his trajectory reflected major ideological splits in late-colonial politics.
impact: His legacy shaped debates on sovereignty, resistance, and leadership across Bengal and South Asia.
highlight: A decisive nationalist voice from Bengal in the final decades of empire.
